disclosure: Public messages use the independently reviewed minimized grading input. Two incidental inventory phrases are redacted and home/evidence directory paths use placeholders. Message hashes bind original, grading and public text. Session IDs are omitted. Full transcripts remain private. Public inputs reproduce calculations, not all private tool observations.

accounting.arithmetic: Exact decimal addition of numeric JSON cost tokens; USD number fields rounded to 10 decimal places. *_decimal strings preserve the exact addition.
accounting.component_assignment: Matched run-record component first, then deterministic main/pilot/grader ordering when a copied receipt appears in multiple components.
accounting.deduplication: Result UUID first, session ID when UUID is absent. Without either, only identical source bytes with an identical saved attempt basename collapse. Identical bodies under distinct attempt filenames remain separate.
accounting.run_record_cost_usd: Corroboration only; never summed, because the original runner defaults a missing total_cost_usd to zero.
accounting.unknowns: A call with no valid consistent observed total is unknown, never zero. Missing, malformed, nonnumeric, negative, nonfinite, and conflicting evidence is retained. Costs are not inferred from tokens or error text.

main_run_cap.runner_behavior: The preregistered runner reserves the per-run cap before starting another run (spent + caps[model] > maxTotal stops new work). This builder does not authorize more calls.
main_run_cap.scope: Main-run trial calls only. Pilots, abandoned pilots, graders/regraders, setup probes, and orchestration do not consume this cap.

pilot_preregistration_comparison.comparison_scope: The four retained pilot runs in pilot/runs.json; abandoned pilot attempts are separate additional costs.

costs.refresh: python3 build-cost-summary.py --root PRIVATE_RECEIPT_DIRECTORY; add --final only after receipt collection ends.
costs.scope: Observed total_cost_usd in saved main-run, all saved pilot (including failed/abandoned), and every saved grader receipt directory. Retry and discarded grader calls are included when receipted.
unobserved_scope: Setup/authentication/sandbox probes and orchestration without saved total_cost_usd receipts are not quantified; absence is not evidence of zero cost.
The preregistration describes a separate Haiku approval-reproduction probe without an inventoried cost receipt. It is outside the four retained pilot comparison.
Provider invoices, taxes, subscription accounting, and unsaved/in-flight calls are not available from this receipt inventory.
